description.p: Recognize, choose, and open your NetSuite SuiteCloud Development Framework (SDF) accounts directly from WebStorm.

ul.li: Show the authentication ID or company, environment, and role in the status bar
Search and filter accounts by environment and role, with current and related accounts grouped together
Refresh accounts without closing the picker or losing valid filters
Open the current or selected account using a locally saved HTTPS NetSuite UI URL
Start account setup through Oracle's WebStorm Account Management settings
Confirm production switches and preserve unrelated project.json content

description.p: Requirements: Account discovery uses an existing SuiteCloud CLI for Node.js installation and its supported Node.js/JDK runtimes. Legacy Java CLI discovery is available as an explicit choice. Account setup requires Oracle's SuiteCloud IDE Plug-in for WebStorm. The authentication ID from project.json remains visible when account discovery is unavailable.

The plugin does not read SuiteCloud credential contents, log raw CLI output, or send automatic telemetry. The IDE may submit exception reports to JetBrains Marketplace manually or automatically according to its error-reporting settings.

p.small: Independent project; not affiliated with or endorsed by Oracle.
